name: Mirror w. décor
desc: With its graceful arch and intricate woodland scene, this mirror from Chic Antique brings a quietly decorative note to the room with a French brocante feel. Fine branches and fern-like leaves weave around little birds and butterflies, while the antique coal finish gives the design a gentle contrast between dark, defined edges and softly coloured nature-inspired detail.The tall shape makes an elegant focal point above a console in the hallway or on a bedroom wall, where its botanical motif can complement greenery, natural textures and country-inspired furnishings.Its restrained palette lets the detailed illustration stand out without overwhelming the wall, while the curved silhouette softens the clean lines of a Nordic interior. Place it where it can catch the eye as you enter, or let it bring visual interest and light to a quiet corner. The botanical scene gives the mirror a gentle, storybook quality, balancing its strong outline with a light, graceful impression.

h1: Trouville Lounge Table in recycled teak
desc: With its rounded top and gently angled legs, the Trouville lounge table from Chic Antique brings a relaxed, natural character to a seating area.
